items.title: Qualcomm, Micron, and Arm Holdings stocks sink, leading chip sector lower
items.summary: Qualcomm, Micron, and Arm Holdings were all trading lower on Thursday as chip stocks continued to slide.

items.title: Postman Private Cloud Now Available in the Microsoft Marketplace
items.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, November 05, 2026--Postman, a leading AI-native API platform, today announced the availability of Postman Private Cloud in the Microsoft Marketplace, the unified online destination for customers to buy trusted cloud solutions, AI apps, and agents to meet their business needs. Postman customers can now discover and deploy trusted solutions through Microsoft Marketplace, with smooth integration and streamlined management across Microsoft Azure and other Microsoft products.

items.title: V29 Capital Management Launches as Independent Private Equity Firm Focused on Technology-Enabled Businesses
items.summary: NEW HAVEN, Conn., November 05, 2026--V29 Capital Management ("V29") today announced its launch as an independent private equity firm focusing on founder-led, technology-enabled businesses at an inflection point in their growth. V29 Capital Management was established as an independent investment firm following its separation from Pritzker Vlock Capital Management. The transaction was backed by funds managed by BlackRock, Sagard, Pomona Capital and other leading firms.

items.title: Tessell Agents for Gemini Bring Agentic Database Lifecycle Management to Enterprise Databases on Google Cloud
items.summary: Tessell (www.tessell.com), one of the leading multi-cloud database-as-a-service (DBaaS) providers, has announced the launch of three specialized agents built leveraging Google's Gemini on Tessell's multi-cloud database platform. The announcement, showcased live by Google at Oracle AI World on Oct 28, introduces a shift toward Agentic Database Lifecycle Management for Tessell customers running complex enterprise database workloads on Google Cloud.

items.title: Fastly Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: FSLY beats Q3'26 earnings estimates as revenues rise 20.2%, fueled by security growth and customer expansion, prompting higher 2026 revenue and earnings forecasts.
